name: Coumarin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1996 — for liver harm

similar.name: Methoxsalen
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for cancer risk

fda.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away. Keep out of the reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a healthcare professional before use.

summary: Coumarin was taken off the market in France starting in 1996 because of liver damage, and a related drug called Methoxsalen carries a boxed warning in the United States for cancer risk [3][4]. According to FDA warnings, people who are pregnant or breastfeeding should ask a healthcare professional before using Coumarin, the drug must be kept away from children, and immediate medical help or a poison control center must be contacted if an overdose occurs [5]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high risk score of 71 for the liver and a low risk score of 21 for the heart [M].
